text: Unblocking a creation path does NOT unlock historical data, and a blocked-creation bug is not a hidden-data bug. Before proposing a backfill, prove the value exists somewhere else: measured 2026-11-18 for delivery DR numbers, 11280 deliveries with 3961 holding a DR and 7319 without, and ZERO of the 7319 were recoverable from the receiving row (dr_number), informal transfers (dl_cashier_withdrawals.dr_number), delivery remarks, or audit_logs.new_data JSON. The value was never sent by the UI, so no second copy existed anywhere - a backfill could only come from the physical paper. State that plainly instead of implying the fix surfaced old records; also check whether the old records were already visible, because 'surface-blocked' and 'never created' need opposite remedies.
